title.zh: 假设检验与 p 值 · 法庭模型判硬币冤不冤
title.en: Hypothesis Testing & p-Values · A Courtroom for a Coin

desc.zh: 先假定硬币公平（无罪推定），再问“如果公平，出现这么极端的结果有多罕见”；显著性水平是愿意冤枉好人的预算。
desc.en: Presume the coin is fair (innocent until proven guilty), then ask how rare a result this extreme would be if it were; the significance level is the budget for convicting an innocent coin.
